_comment: Verified GetYourGuide product pages, keyed by activity slug.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Every generated affiliate link is a SEARCH url -
getyourguide.com/s/?q=Westminster+Abbey+London - which drops the reader on
a list to hunt through rather than on a tour with a price and a rating.
affiliate.mjs prefers an entry here when one exists, and falls back to the
search url otherwise. It lives in data/ rather than in the Activities sheet
so a re-export cannot wipe it.
HOW THESE WERE CHOSEN. Matched from GetYourGuide's own Bestseller coverage,
Deals & promotions and New activities exports (2 September 2026), then
checked by eye one at a time. Fuzzy matching over those exports proposed 16
candidates for 100 activities; 8 survived. Review count separated them
cleanly - every match above 300 reviews was right, every match below 3 was
wrong (Churchill War Rooms matched a 690-euro private walking tour, the
Design Museum matched a children's craft workshop in Upminster, and the
London Stadium - West Ham - matched the Emirates, the wrong club entirely).
THE BAR FOR ADDING ONE. The tour must be FOR the venue, not merely mention
it: an entry ticket or the venue's own official tour, never a multi-stop
coach trip that stops there. Check the URL by hand before adding it. A
wrong product page is worse than the search link it replaces, because the
reader trusts it more.
reviews and rating are recorded as of the date above so a later pass can
tell a stale entry from a fresh one. They are not read by any code.
